questions.question:
6 friends are sitting around a circular table. Vini, Urja and Tanvi are sitting facing the centre and two out of Abhay, Bala and Chan are not sitting facing the centre. Vini is sitting second to the left of Chan. Urja is sitting second to the right of Abhay. Bala is sitting third to the left of Tanvi. Chan is sitting second to the right of Tanvi. Abhay is sitting next to Vini.

Who is sitting fourth to the right of Chan?
questions.solution:
Given: 6 friends are sitting around a circular table.

Vini, Urja, and Tanvi are sitting facing the center,

And two out of Abhay, Bala, and Chan are not sitting facing the center.

1) Vini is sitting second to the left of Chan. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5292ddfd52438ce384295b04965f47c897a9ba50ac174585ccfaa070f2d7308.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4535b3fd6db3babf43cc5cbf598c7c4277887650d72d665156daafe0e513a9dd.png] 

2) Chan is sitting second to the right of Tanvi who is facing the centre so case 2 is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ffa0623134b1111ae88b65d2582210e87d08c2596f14b67f8843e259cffe487.png] 

3) Bala is sitting third to the left of Tanvi. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d36aee2444d1fbf0118af7241822be31ecf7c1ae28059284f9dd42984ce78f93.png] 

4) Abhay is sitting next to Vini.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fae7388fe6bbee1c86ed27aeea8b8a60b4e0ec85ed1ae9c2960a6e5fe05651b.png] 

5) Urja is sitting second to the right of Abhay. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6d69fbbf7c69b89d6c1df3d0807a66861f80ed14b14b37bf0758e71fd66d127.png] 

Here, '**Vini**' is sitting fourth to the right of Chan.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question: J, K, L, M, O and P are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Both L and M are immediate neighbours of J. Only one person sits between M and P. O sits second to the right of J. O is not an immediate neighbour of L. Who is sitting to the immediate right of K?
questions.solution:
**Given:** J, K, L, M, O and P are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) O sits second to the right of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9df8548f4b6a695eb8b459d32e80116260d248f038e84ce67f676d992a718844.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb9173f4291391c0b961bd7d0a33d0e082f014c7a3a306cb7daca0ea42414f47.png] 

2) Both L and M are immediate neighbours of J.

3) O is not an immediate neighbour of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6949fba137ca9d60ed05d3b8283d98c5d404d4050a4495476272e1d600aed740.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c7bd6e76b4075629e5883d7bc45e4b4773c46911088c43189a5a7932b270a4a.png] 

4) Only one person sits between M and P.

After positioning P only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. K. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/476146eca55896b74e05e7ba4609d7ca1a4fc78ecd9dc172469bd4d397bc1b52.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87ba6748ed018606a088cee37963b5e24927a9b88224a028c153d1da0d43d4a9.png] 

Thus, L is sitting to the immediate right of K.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.

After positioning S only one position is left which will be occ
